name: Servers
author: Dinesh Korukonda
description: Server monitoring and remote management in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Server health status dot, server detail panel, service management, SSH terminal launcher, and desktop notifications.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the plugin polls the daemon for server state updates.

schema.label: Daemon Unix socket path
schema.description: Path to the omarchy-server daemon Unix domain socket.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a server goes offline or recovers.

schema.label: Terminal emulator
schema.description: Terminal emulator to use for 'Open SSH'. Supported: auto, foot, kitty, xterm. 'auto' tries foot then kitty then xterm.

schema.label: Log lines
schema.description: Default number of log lines to tail when opening the log viewer.
